verdict.rationale: Llama ships as open weights that can be downloaded and run entirely locally on desktops, mobile and edge devices (llama.cpp, ExecuTorch). That implies the user, not Meta, controls where prompts and outputs are stored and when they are deleted. However, no evidence explicitly documents data-retention or deletion controls, so delivery is only implied by the self-hosted deployment model. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of retention/deletion policy or controls, coverage of retention for Meta-hosted or partner-hosted usage, independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
